name: Sophon
desc:
Sophon is [Samnang](entity:nanji)'s brother, and they're both kinsmen of the of Clan Mofisu. Both resided in [Etrea](faction:etrea) until war broke out and he had to answer their call of arms.

Sophon seemed to have died or gone missing. This is signified by the fact that the equipment that we find is now rusty and bloody. His [Scattered Possessions](entity:chipped_sword) also has some blood on it, signifying that something bad has happened, most likely in some kind of battle at the [Viridian Sanctuary](location:viridian_sanctuary_ruins) and how it came to ruins.
